replayHint: Walk through the owner screens: team, schedule, route finder, requests, and invoices.
welcomeTitle: You're ready to run the company
welcomeDescription: Your profile, company, and first client are set up. This short guide walks through the screens owners use every day. You can quit anytime.
addTechnicianDescription: Invite a technician here so you can assign pools and routes. Enter their email, choose the Technician role, and send the invite. You don't have to finish it to continue the guide.
scheduleDescription: This is the weekly schedule. Use it to see which pools each technician visits and to move work between days.
routeFinderDescription: Drop a new pool address on the map to see which route and weekday it fits best.
requestsDescription: Requests technicians send from the field show up here, so you can approve work, parts, or follow-ups.
invoicesDescription: Use Create invoice to bill a client for a one-time charge. You can come back and send it whenever you're ready.
recurringDescription: Recurring templates generate invoices on a schedule, which fits weekly or monthly pool service.
doneDescription: You can reopen this guide anytime from Quick Start or your account menu.
